title: Adult skills, workplace use and earnings in USA and Japan
publisher: OECD (PIAAC), national USA and Japan survey programs
license_or_access_terms: OECD data terms with attribution and pass-through acknowledgment; Reader Companion CC BY 4.0, third-party cover credit retained
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete USA and Japan CSV public-use files, plus official codebook/user-guide context; retain all plausible values, replicate weights, and missing-value codes.

measurement_dates.description: Cycle 2 collection September 2022–August 2023; USA/Japan CSV release December 2024. Current retrieval freezes exact bytes; other countries received later revisions.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Anonymous public-use survey records: source weighting, proficiency estimation, derivation, coarsening and suppression have already occurred. These are not raw interview recordings.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Existing OECD reports already study skills and earnings. Two countries are not global coverage; country-specific suppression and earnings coding affect comparability. OECD landing/terms pages were verified via public web retrieval but their direct local HTML downloads returned 403; local generated source notes identify that limitation.

license_evidence.verification: Public web retrieval on 2026-09-14 succeeded; local HTTP clients returned 403. Data reuse and redistribution permitted with OECD attribution and pass-through acknowledgment, subject to additional third-party restrictions.
